decision_conditions: <p>It has not been demonstrated to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority that the use or operations described in the application would be lawful within the meaning of S192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) if instituted or begun at the time of the application. Specifically the proposed use of the building as a supported housing with total of five residents and a staff would result in a material change of use from a Large House of Multiple Occupation (Use Class Sui Generis) to Dwellinghouse (Use Class C3(b)) and would therefore not be within the tolerances of the Town and Country Planning (Use Class) Order 1987 (as amended).&nbsp;</p>

<p>The proposed alteration from window to a door to the rear elevation is also considered to fall within the definition of development under Section 55(1A) and 55(2)(a)(ii) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and there are no permitted development rights that would allow a building in Use Class Sui Generis to implement such works which would result in the material change of the external appearance of the building on site. Planning permission would therefore be required.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>The proposal is therefore not a lawful development.</p>
description: Certificate of Lawful Development (Proposed): Change of Use from Large HMO (Class Sui Generis) to supported housing (Class C3(b)) with total of five residents and a staff; alteration from window to a door at rear
